official_identity_sources.observation: RODA identifies ORSON 002 as the foldable director lounge chair by Gordon Guillaumier, with teak structure, Batyline net, dimensions 66 x 60 x 78 cm, seat height 37 cm and arm height 58 cm. The same page advertises collection 2D and 3D drawings only through the reserved area.

The current official one-page Fact Sheet visually confirms the foldable lounge-chair form, teak structure, Batyline upholstery, 8 kg weight, 660 x 600 x 780 mm dimensions and Sky fabric option. Its small isometric illustration is identity evidence, not native Plan/Front/Side CAD geometry.
The official reserved area presents an email/password login form. No account was created and no authenticated download was attempted.

project_ifc_identity_evidence.note: The IFC style names provide project-model configuration evidence. The official Fact Sheet lists teak and Sky Batyline as valid materials, but the style names are not a purchase order or manufacturer shop drawing.

official_product_cad.reason: RODA routes the collection 2D and 3D downloads to an authenticated reserved area. No manufacturer account was created, and publicly visible third-party DWG files were not substituted.
